senses.gloss: €1P. (श्मीलति) To wink, contract the eyelids, twinkle.

€1Ā. (स्मयते, स्मित) 
__1 To smile, laugh (gently); काकुत्स्थ ईषत्स्मयमान आस्त [[Bk. 2. 11]]; 15. 8; स्मयमानं बदनाम्बुजं स्मरामि [[Bv. 2. 27.]] 
__2 To bloom, expand; [[Pt. 1. 136.]] -Caus. (स्माययति-ते) 
__1 To cause a smile by, cause to smile. 
__2 To laugh at, deride. 
__3 To astonish (स्माययते in this sense). -Desid. (सिस्मयिषते) To wish to smile.

p. p. 
__1 Smiled, smiling. 
__2 Expanded, blown, blossomed; एकेन स्मितपाटलाधररुचो जल्पन्त्यनल्पाक्षरम् [[Pt. 1. 136.]] 
-तम् A smile, gentle laugh; सस्मितं ‘with a smile’; सविलक्षस्मितम् &c. 
-Comp. 
-दृश् a. having a smiling look. (-f.) a handsome woman. 
-पूर्वम् ind. smilingly, with a smile; सप्तर्षिभिस्तान् स्मितपूर्बमाह [[Ku. 7. 47.]] 
-मुख a. having a smiling face. 
-वाच् a. speaking with a smile. 
-शालिन् a. smiling. 
-शोभिन् a. smiling beautifully.

€10U. (स्मेटयति-ते) 
__1 To slight, scorn, despise. 
__2 To love. 
__3 To go.
